risk_note: RV2 settlement rights (FU-REASON-SUB-STALE-ROW-MANUAL; ruling D10-969, the money r2 S2 of B1-09v #2761). A manual sub-reason stored on an order_rights row (no origin: it is not carried by the closing input) now fills an ended PUNISH order only while orders.reason_sub_manual is false, both when a later input resolves the row and when D10-699 reopens it; an order whose sub-reason an operator set by hand afterwards (adminSetOrderReasonSub, including none = NULL) is left alone and gets no replacement audit. A real replacement of an automatic value writes one order_reason_sub_set audit on the same transaction (actor system:settlement, admin_id null as the existing reopen audit, source stored_rights_choice with the order_rights id, no personal data); the audit port is checked before updateRightsResult. Inputs that carry their own choice (D10-957 duplicate import, B1-09v round 2 write-back) are unchanged. No amount, status, reason, balance, ledger entry, R6 or clawback is written; only reason PUNISH is touched. Only rights-command.ts changes, plus its first unit tests (9). The two FU-REASON-SUB-MANUAL-TESTS-R3 cases that pin behaviour main already has were split into the test-change task B1-09zb (#2791) under D10-903 (A), since red-check does not exempt new tests. Integration reason-sub-stale-row plus reason-sub-manual and the related frozen order / settlement directories 606/606 pass; api unit 4804 pass.

reviews.note: Codex usage limit exhausted until 2026-11-15, so per D10-823 ④ a fresh independent Claude (claude-run.sh review --review-type money) reviewed the whole implementation from the last rule-test commit: pass with no findings; both behaviours the implementer reported (an audit when the order already holds the same value automatically, the manual flag going false -> true; no broken-row throw when the order is already set by hand) judged harmless. Checklist rounding na, sign na, idempotency ok, concurrency ok, partial_refund na, clock ok, app_id ok. couli-runs/B1-09za/review-money-r1.json.
